findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new logger, discarding recorded calls
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext always returns NewTestLogger(), a fresh instance unrelated to the receiver `f`. Production code (LoggerMiddleware.logRequest) now calls `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` instead of `m.logger.Info(...)`. Any test that constructs a TestLogger, passes it into NewLoggerMiddleware, and later asserts on the original TestLogger's InfoLogs/ErrorLogs/etc. fields will never see the recorded call, because the Info call lands on the discarded, newly-created instance instead of the original. This silently breaks the ability of TestLogger to verify logging behavior through code paths that use FromContext, which is now the primary logging path in LoggerMiddleware, and can make pre-existing or future tests pass vacuously without exercising real assertions.

findings.title: traceID field dropped from 'Plugin Request Completed' log line
findings.body: The previous logRequest implementation explicitly added a 'traceID' field to logParams via tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false). This logic (and the tracing import) has been removed, and the new instrumentContext helper in contextual_logger_middleware.go (which supplies the contextual attributes now used by m.logger.FromContext(ctx)) only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName/dsUID and uname -- it never adds traceID. As a result, the 'Plugin Request Completed' log entries emitted by LoggerMiddleware no longer contain a traceID field, removing the ability to correlate these logs with distributed traces. This appears to be an unintended regression rather than part of the stated rename/refactor.

findings.title: Test function name not updated after renaming middleware to MetricsMiddleware
findings.body: The file was renamed from instrumentation_middleware_test.go to metrics_middleware_test.go and the middleware type/constructor were renamed to MetricsMiddleware/newMetricsMiddleware, but the test function itself is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware. This leaves a naming inconsistency that defeats the purpose of the rename-for-consistency chore and will confuse future readers searching for tests related to MetricsMiddleware.

findings.title: Logger name 'plugin.instrumentation' left over after renaming to metrics middleware
findings.body: NewLoggerMiddleware is now instantiated with log.New("plugin.instrumentation"), but 'instrumentation' terminology was intentionally renamed away to 'metrics' in this PR for the MetricsMiddleware. The logger name still implies this is the metrics/instrumentation path even though it is unrelated to MetricsMiddleware (it backs LoggerMiddleware). This stale name is misleading for anyone searching logs or metrics by this logger name and should be updated to match the new naming scheme.
